situation.problem_text:
Topic: The Mystery of Pi: Definition and Historical Evolution

Target audience: Middle school students (Ages 12-14)

Section: section_1 — The Hook: The Constant Ratio

Lecture lines:
Circles have a secret, constant ratio.
Roll a circle once.
The distance is three-point-one-four diameters.

Planned animations:
Draw a circle with radius r = 1.0 (Color: #FFFFFF).
Animate the circumference C appearing along the circle edge.
Display the ratio C / d = Pi label (Color: #FFFF00).

Section: section_2 — Defining Pi: The Mathematical Formalism

Lecture lines:
Pi is circumference divided by diameter.
Big or small, the ratio stays constant.
Pi is an endless, irrational number.

Planned animations:
Display the formula C = πd (Color: #FF00FF).
Show d changing while π remains constant (Color: #00FFFF).
Highlight the static ratio π with a glowing effect.

Section: section_3 — Historical Evolution: The Method of Exhaustion

Lecture lines:
Archimedes squeezed the circle with polygons.
More sides get closer to the circle.
This trapped the value of Pi.

Planned animations:
Display a polygon inside a circle.
Iteratively increase sides of the polygon towards the circle.
Label the perimeter approaching the circumference (Color: #00FF00).

Section: section_4 — Modern Perspectives and Wrap-up

Lecture lines:
Pi powers modern technology today.
It helps your phone navigate routes.
Pi bridges geometry and the infinite.

Planned animations:
Summarize Pi as a universal constant in nature.
Show digits of Pi cascading down the screen.
Fade out everything to black.

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        self.place_at_grid(formula, "B2", scale_factor=2.0)
        self.play(Write(formula))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FF00FF")

        circle = Circle(radius=0.5, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_at_grid(circle, "E3", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        d_line = Line(start=circle.get_left(), end=circle.get_right(), color=WHITE)
        d_label = MathTex("d", color=WHITE).next_to(d_line, UP)

            circle.animate.set_radius(1.0),
            d_line.animate.scale(2.0, about_point=circle.get_center()),
            run_time=2
        )
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#00FFFF")

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Highlight the static ratio π with a glowing effect
        pi_val = Tex(r"$\pi \approx 3.14159...$", font_size=48, color=YELLOW)
        self.place_at_grid(pi_val, "C5", scale_factor=1.5)
        
        glow = SurroundingRectangle(pi_val, color=YELLOW, buff=0.1, fill_opacity=0.3)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(pi_val), Create(glow))
        self.play(Indicate(pi_val), run_time=2)
        self.lecture[2].set_color(YELLOW)
        self.wait(1)

from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Historical Evolution: The Method of Exhaustion", [
            "Archimedes squeezed the circle with polygons.", 
            "More sides get closer to the circle.", 
            "This trapped the value of Pi."
        ])
        
        # Define base objects
        circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color=BLUE)
        self.place_at_grid(circle, 'C3', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Archimedes squeezed the circle with polygons.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        polygon = RegularPolygon(n=4, radius=1.5, color=RED)
        self.place_at_grid(polygon, 'C3', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Create(circle), Create(polygon))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # More sides get closer to the circle.
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(YELLOW))
        
        for n in [6, 12, 24, 48, 96]:
            new_polygon = RegularPolygon(n=n, radius=1.5, color=RED)
            self.place_at_grid(new_polygon, 'C3', scale_factor=1.0)
            self.play(Transform(polygon, new_polygon), run_time=0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # This trapped the value of Pi.
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE), self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GREEN))
        
        label = Text("Perimeter ≈ Circumference", font_size=20, color="#00FF00")
        self.place_at_grid(label, 'F3', scale_factor=1.0)
        self.play(Write(label))
        self.wait(2)
